rules.statement: If the vendor fails to assist in the action by absenting himself on the trial date, the vendee is not obliged to incur further expenditure by pursuing an appeal. The vendor should have financed the plaintiff to appeal if he wanted the matter carried further.
rules.supporting_quote: "The vendor was not formally made a party to the Court of Requests case. No appeal was preferred against the judgment-which was dated September 11, 1934. In the present action the purchase price was claimed, in respect of this allotment, and also certain costs incurred in respect of the conveyance and the Court of Requests case."
